# Simple English Wikipedia

> A free, community-edited encyclopedia written in simplified English for accessibility and learning.

Simple English Wikipedia is a version of Wikipedia using Basic English vocabulary and shorter sentences to make knowledge accessible to learners, non-native speakers, and people with cognitive disabilities. The site is powered by MediaWiki and maintained by the Wikimedia Foundation under open-content licenses.

## Getting Started

- [Main Page](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page): Simple English Wikipedia homepage - free, community-edited encyclopedia
- [Simple Start](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Simple_start): Getting started guide for new users and account creation on Wikipedia
- [Introduction](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Introduction): Introduction guide for new users on how to edit and use Wikipedia
- [Help Contents](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Contents): Help center with editing guides and writing style guidelines

## About Simple English Wikipedia

- [About](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:About): About page explaining Simple English Wikipedia overview and purpose
- [Simple English Wikipedia Project](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_English_Wikipedia): Main article about Simple English Wikipedia project and accessibility
- [Encyclopedia](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Encyclopedia): Article about encyclopedia definition and digital encyclopedias

## Editing & Writing Standards

- [How to Write Simple English Pages](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:How_to_write_Simple_English_pages): Writing guide for Simple English pages with language standards
- [Useful Pages](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Useful_pages): Directory of useful editing resources and Wikipedia policies

## Community & Support

- [Simple Talk](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Simple_talk): Community discussion forum for Wikipedia editing guidelines and help
- [Contact Us](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contact_us): Contact page for article problems, copyright issues, and community support
- [Talk: Main Page](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:Main_Page): Discussion page for Main Page edits and Wikipedia guidelines

## Administration & Moderation

- [Recent Changes](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:RecentChanges): Recent changes tracking and wiki moderation dashboard for administrators
- [Special Pages](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:SpecialPages): Directory of special wiki administration and maintenance tools
- [Statistics](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Statistics): Wiki statistics showing page metrics and user analytics

## Optional

- [Random Article](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Random): Random article feature linking to encyclopedia content
- [What Links Here](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:WhatLinksHere/Main_Page): Backlinks tracker showing pages linking to Main Page
- [Related Changes](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:RecentChangesLinked/Main_Page): Change tracking for pages linked to Main Page with watchlist
- [Alternative Homepage](https://simple.wikipedia.org/w/index.php): Alternative homepage for Simple English Wikipedia
